question: Is a photo a record of what was there?
answer: Partly a reconstruction. Each pixel on a camera sensor measures only one colour, behind a red, green or blue filter. The other two values are interpolated from the neighbours. Every ordinary digital photograph is roughly two-thirds informed guesswork, done well enough that nobody notices.
move: Two of every three colour values in your photos were guessed.
source: Bayer filter demosaicing, standard in digital sensors
